verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗਹੁ ਅੰਗੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨ ਗੰਗਹੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਤਰੰਗ ਉਠਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)gahu a(n)g upaion ga(n)gahu jaan tara(n)g uThaiaa|

en.bdb: Guru Nanak created him ( Guru Angad) from his limbs as the waves are produced by Ganges out of itself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਗਹੀਰੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gahir ga(n)bheer gaheer gun gurmukh gur gobi(n)dh sadhaiaa|

en.bdb: Embodied with deep and sublime attributes he (Angad) was known by gurmukhs as the form of the (imperceptible) supreme soul (paramatman).

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਣਿਹਾਰੁ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਲੇਪੁ ਨਾ ਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dhukh sukh dhaataa dhenihaar dhukh sukh samasar lep naa laiaa|

en.bdb: He himself is bestower of pleasures and pains but remains always without any blot.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲੇ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਰਚਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur chelaa chelaa guroo gur chele parachaa parachaiaa|

en.bdb: The love between the Guru and the disciple was such that the disciple became Guru and the Guru disciple.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਖਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਫਲ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਪਿਉ ਪੁਤਹੁ ਪੁਤੁ ਪਿਉ ਪਤੀਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: birakhahu fal fal te birakh piau putahu put piau pateeaaiaa|

en.bdb: It happened in the same manner as tree creates fruit and from fruit is created tree, or as father becomes happy over son and son feels happy in obeying the orders of father.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham sabadh surat liv alakh lakhaiaa|

en.bdb: His consiconsness merged into word and the perfect transcendental Brahm made him see the imperceptible (Lord).
Now Guru Angad got established as ( the extended form of) Baba Nanak.
